title: The Monk Who Watched Three Percent
content:
He had called it safe because the loop had a name.

A wallet bought the yield token, pushed implied APY toward twenty, dumped. Three percent. The loopers had less than three percent of room. Thirty-six million left the way steam leaves a kettle.

They said the fifteen-minute TWAP worked as designed. He poured the tea. Design, he thought, is just a word for who gets liquidated.
